_comment: Example ORG POLICY BUNDLE. An admin distributes this document out of band (MDM, config management, a signed package) and pins it by digest with 'chrome-bridge policy bundle lock <path> --lockfile <path>'. A host applies it only when its sha256 matches the lockfile; anything else fails closed to the built-in default policy. Point a machine at it from bridge_policy.json: {"policyBundle": {"path": "...", "lockfile": "..."}, "default": {...}}. The local file layers on top and can only tighten: composed deniedActions/deniedOrigins are the union of this bundle's entries and the local ones.
